name: Default
shortDescription: Local-first collaboration server with chat, pages, databases and files, plus the Colanode web client, backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector and Valkey.

alerts.message: HTTPS is required: the web client stores its data with browser features that only work on a secure origin, and the server is configured with an https web address.
The web client starts with no server. Open the app, choose to add a server and enter https://<your-domain>/api/config, then register. The desktop apps connect with the same URL.
Registration is open: anyone who reaches the server can create a verified account. Set account.verificationType to manual or email in config.json to restrict sign-ups.
